title: Building Agentic Workflows With LangChain And Temporal
description: In this article, I'll show you how to combine the agentic reasoning of LangChain with the robust workflow orchestration of Temporal to build workflows comprised of agents that can think, adapt, and act on your behalf. As generative AI and workflow automation mature, the ability to create intelligent, self-correcting systems is more accessible than ever.

title: Custom Agentic Applications With LangGraph And Dockerized MCP
description: In this post, I will show you how to leverage Docker's MCP catalog and LangChain/LangGraph to create your own agent that can think, reason, self-correct, and perform tasks on your behalf.

title: Sweet-Talk Your Database Into Revealing Its Secrets With Dockerized MCP Servers
description: Docker has not-so-quietly revolutionized how we interact with AI tools through their new MCP Toolkit. This article explores how to use the MCP Toolkit to run a Postgres database and interact with it using AI models.

title: Whale-Sized Intelligence - Running LLMs with Docker Desktop
description: Docker has quietly launched something really exciting: the Docker Model Runner, a new feature built into Docker Desktop that lets you pull, run, and interact with LLMs — all from the CLI or your apps, just like you would with containers

title: Maintaining Docker image security with Docker Scout
description: Docker Scout is a platform and service that helps improve the security of software supply chains by analyzing your Docker images and providing detailed information about their security postures.

title: Deploying A Kubernetes Cluster To PVE Using GitLab CI
description: This guide will show you how to deploy a Kubernetes cluster onto two or more virtual machines hosted within a PVE homelab environment.

title: Full stack JavaScript app utilizing JSON-relational duality views
description: This article describes how to build a full stack Flappy Bird clone backed by Oracle's JSON-relational duality views feature in Oracle Free23c.

title: Express, TypeScript, and Oracle Advanced Queue
description: The goal of this article is to demonstrate how to use Oracle Advanced Queuing and how it can be a great alternative to message brokers such as RabbitMQ when building applications on top of an Oracle database.

title: Express, TypeScript, and Oracle Advanced Queue
description: In this guide, we will deploy an existing containerized application to OCI without creating a single service manually.

title: Pixel - Your tiny, offline AI companion
description: This article will demonstrate how to build an AI assistant, lightweight enough to run on a Raspberry Pi 5.

title: Pixel - Your tiny, offline AI companion
description: This article describes how to deploy a Node.js application and its required infrastructure to the cloud.
